We have tool estimate_distance that takes cityA and cityB zipcodes. We need zipcodes. We can use get_zipcode_based_on_city for each city. Then estimate_distance. Then send_message to Bob. Need Bob\'s user ID. We can get user ID via get_user_id with user name "鮑勃". Then send_message. So steps: get_zipcode_based_on_city for 河霧, get_zipcode_based_on_city for 石溪. Then estimate_distance. Then get_user_id for 鮑勃. Then send_message. Let\'s do that.')
